name: Chaser Pro tubeless (真空)
aliases: 吉路尔 Chaser Pro 真空胎

origin.basis: Shandong Jiluer Tire Co., Tengzhou, Shandong (brand directory).

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Tubeless version of the JILUER Chaser Pro, sold in 28 mm.
weight_basis: The shop listing gives no weight.

availability.note: Found in a Taobao shop listing; no official JILUER store listing for the tubeless version was read.

price_observations.conditions: Shop price on 2026-11-01 for the CHASER PRO 28C tubeless option. Single or pair not stated.

caveats: Only one shop listing was read; weight, TPI and pressure are not published.
Owner reports of bulging in a 2025 batch of an unnamed JILUER tubeless tire are not attributed to this model.
